preconditions.description: The length of the permutations is between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: Each number from 1 to n occurs exactly once in each permutation.
preconditions.description: Each number in the permutations p and s occurs exactly once.
It is guaranteed that there is a way to transform permutation p into permutation s by swapping elements.

postconditions.expression: The output contains the minimum number of coins required to transform permutation p into permutation s.
postconditions.description: The first line of the output is the minimum number of coins.

postconditions.expression: The output contains the sequence of swap operations that achieves the transformation.
postconditions.description: The second line of the output is the number of swap operations, followed by the operations themselves.
